items.exampleEn: Try not to start every sentence with a conjunction like 'and'.
items.exampleZh: 盡量不要每個句子都用 and 這類連接詞開頭。

items.exampleEn: Brackets look like two curved lines around a word.
items.exampleZh: 括號看起來像圍住一個字的兩條弧線。

items.exampleEn: The office needs a literal translation of the letter, not a short summary.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室需要那封信的逐字翻譯，而不是簡短的摘要。

items.exampleEn: The number of dropouts at the school has fallen since lessons became more practical.
items.exampleZh: 自從課程變得更實用，這所學校的輟學生人數就下降了。

items.exampleEn: The time on the clock was written as 7:30, with a colon in the middle.
items.exampleZh: 時鐘上的時間寫成 7:30，中間有一個冒號。

items.exampleEn: This book of famous quotations sits on my desk.
items.exampleZh: 這本名言錄放在我的書桌上。

items.exampleEn: A good tutor notices exactly where a student gets stuck.
items.exampleZh: 好的家教能準確看出學生卡在哪裡。

items.exampleEn: Poets often count syllables carefully when they write very short poems.
items.exampleZh: 詩人寫極短的詩時，常會仔細計算音節。

items.sentenceEn: The word banana has three syllables.
items.sentenceZh: banana 這個字有三個音節。

items.audioEn: My math tutor comes on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so I can't join practice on those days.
items.audioZh: 我的數學家教星期二和星期四來，所以那兩天我不能參加練習。
items.questionZh: 說話者哪兩天不能參加練習？

items.sentenceEn: Words like and, but and so are common conjunctions.
items.sentenceZh: and、but、so 這些字是常見的連接詞。

items.sentenceEn: Put the extra information in brackets at the end of the sentence.
items.sentenceZh: 把補充資訊放在句尾的括號裡。

items.stemEn: Use a ____ before a list, like this: apples, pears and grapes.
items.stemZh: 列舉之前要用冒號，例如：蘋果、梨子和葡萄。

items.stemEn: 'It's raining cats and dogs' has nothing to do with animals; its ____ meaning makes no sense.
items.stemZh: 「下貓下狗」跟動物沒關係，照字面意思理解根本說不通。

items.passageEn: When I was in high school, I struggled with English writing, so my parents found me a tutor. She was a university student who had once been a dropout but later returned to finish her degree. In our first lesson, she showed me how to use a colon and brackets correctly. She also explained that a conjunction can join two short sentences into one longer one. To help with speaking, we clapped out the syllables of difficult words. She warned me not to translate idioms in a literal way. At the end of each lesson, she gave me a famous quotation to think about. Thanks to her patience, I slowly began to excel at writing.
items.passageZh: 我讀高中時英文寫作很吃力，所以爸媽幫我找了一位家教。她是大學生，曾經輟學，後來又回去完成學位。第一堂課，她教我怎麼正確使用冒號和括號。她也說明，連接詞可以把兩個短句接成一個長句。為了練口說，我們拍手打出難字的音節。她提醒我不要照字面翻譯慣用語。每堂課結束時，她都會給我一句名言思考。多虧她的耐心，我的寫作漸漸變得出色。

questions.questionZh: 家教在第一堂課教了什麼？
options: 怎麼準備大學的入學考試

questions.questionZh: 這位家教是什麼樣的人？
options: 曾輟學後又復學的大學生
剛從國外留學回來的研究生
已經退休多年的高中英文老師
作者爸媽公司的老同事

items.promptZh: 請在文章裡把引文標示清楚，並寫出作者是誰。
referenceEn: Please mark the quotations clearly in your essay and say who wrote them.
In your essay, please mark each quotation clearly and name its author.
rubricZh: quotation 指「引文」（例如 mark the quotations）
「標示清楚」可寫，例如 mark clearly 等；「寫出作者」可寫，例如 say who wrote them、name the author 等

items.promptZh: 她週末當家教，教一個小學生數學。
referenceEn: She tutors a primary school student in math on weekends.
On weekends, she tutors an elementary school student in math.
rubricZh: tutor 可當動詞「當家教、輔導」（例如 tutors a student in math 等）；寫 works as a tutor for… 也正確
習慣的事用現在式；「小學生」可寫，例如 primary school student、elementary school student 等
